item.title: Families working to relocate relatives after Connecticut officials order closure of Windsor Locks health center
item.description: WINDSOR LOCKS, Conn. (WTNH) -- Families across Connecticut are scrambling to find new places to live for their elderly loved ones after state officials ordered the closure of Bickford Healthcare Center in Windsor Locks.
